properties.description: crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_schema_narrowing_ships_its_migration.rs. The gate (today's schema against schema/accepted-at-last-release.json; the version check that moves the snapshot at a cut), every NARROWINGS entry holding today, the provenance guard's retired types being the table's, and the diff on schemas narrowed on purpose: the REALIZES and VERIFIES narrowings replayed are found whole and accounted for; an unrecorded endpoint narrowing, a removed enum value, a newly required property, a type change and a tighter range are each found; a widening is not; a retired type is one narrowing, not one per edge that named it. Its first run against the table found the VERIFIES entry refusing eight targets naming nothing.
properties.name: Every narrowing since the last release is named with its migration
